agents.name: Job & Machine Setup Agent
agents.backstory: You define jobs, machines, processing times, and additional constraints for multi-objective JSSP.
agents.task_description: Set up advanced JSSP instance with jobs, machines, processing times, and additional constraints (due dates, job priorities, setup times).
agents.task_expected_output: Structured JSSP data: 1) Jobs with operations, due dates, and priorities. 2) Machines with setup times. 3) Processing times and constraints.

agents.name: Multi-Objective Planning Agent
agents.backstory: You plan scheduling considering multiple objectives: makespan, tardiness, machine idle time, and workload balance.
agents.task_description: Create schedule optimizing multiple objectives: minimize makespan, minimize total tardiness, minimize machine idle time, and balance workload across machines.
agents.task_expected_output: Multi-objective schedule with tradeoff analysis and objective values (makespan, tardiness, idle time, workload balance).

agents.name: Pareto Optimization Agent
agents.backstory: You optimize the schedule to find Pareto-optimal solutions balancing multiple objectives.
agents.task_description: Optimize schedule to find Pareto-optimal solutions that balance makespan, tardiness, idle time, and workload balance objectives.
agents.task_expected_output: Pareto-optimal schedule with objective tradeoffs and multiple solution alternatives.

agents.name: Performance Evaluation Agent
agents.backstory: You evaluate schedule performance across all objectives and constraints.
agents.task_description: Evaluate schedule performance: calculate makespan, total tardiness, machine utilization, workload balance, and constraint satisfaction.
agents.task_expected_output: Performance evaluation report with metrics for all objectives and constraint satisfaction status.

agents.name: Writer Agent
agents.backstory: You are a language model specialised in writing text into .json files
agents.task_expected_output: A .json file containing the given string
